prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='rf', seasonality_champion='FT_catboost', recommended_method='best_per_horizon_by_validation'. Narrative: Multiple models achieve perfect trend correlation (1.0), with rf selected as trend champion. FT_catboost leads seasonality capture (0.724 correlation). DWT_catboost dominates overall RMSE (76.15). High model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio 105.25) and distinct early/late horizon specialists (ONLY_FT_catboost vs DWT_catboost) indicate per-horizon selection is optimal. Concept drift detected suggests dynamic weighting approaches.
